clawbass-bonanza.description: A fishing-themed 6 × 5 grid with pays anywhere and cascades. A progress mechanic gradually opens fishing claws that increase wins.
clawbass-bonanza.feature: During free spins, opened fishing lines persist and can pull in multipliers. Bonus Buy offers different numbers of active claws at the start of the bonus.
clawbass-bonanza.note: Clawbuster's official page lists RTP 95% and very high volatility. Float Multipliers can reach 100×, while a win can reach 6 000 stakes. The developer describes this amount as a possible result, rather than a separately established maximum win.
clawbass-bonanza.metricsNote: Clawbuster publishes RTP 95% and Very High volatility. In the Float Multipliers description, the publisher separately states that the result can reach 6 000x the original bet. Slotfolio stores this figure as stated potential, rather than a separately announced fixed maximum-win cap.

clawbass-bonanza-free-rush.description: A ClawBass sequel on a 6 × 5 grid. Cascades combine with bait symbols and the progress of six fishing lines, each able to pull in a multiplier.
clawbass-bonanza-free-rush.feature: Treasure multipliers reach 100x per line. Free Spins Purchase allows the bonus to continue with already opened fishing lines, without a new Scatter trigger.
clawbass-bonanza-free-rush.note: Clawbuster's official page lists RTP 94.97% and very high volatility. Treasure Multipliers can reach 100×, while a win can reach 6 000 stakes. The developer describes this amount as a possible result, rather than a separately established maximum win.
clawbass-bonanza-free-rush.metricsNote: Clawbuster publishes RTP 94.97% and Very High volatility. Its Treasure Multipliers description states that the total win can reach 6 000x the original bet. Slotfolio stores 6 000x as stated potential, rather than a separately stated fixed cap.

3-claws-of-aztec-fire.description: A 5 × 3 grid leads into Hold & Win with three claw types: one doubles values, another becomes a jackpot coin, and the third collects all visible coins.
3-claws-of-aztec-fire.feature: Five coins trigger three respins. New bonus symbols return the counter to three, while filling all 15 positions opens Grand 10 000x.
3-claws-of-aztec-fire.note: Clawbuster's official game page lists RTP 95% and high volatility.

great-clawsby-deluxe.description: Five reels and 50 paylines combine stacked Wilds with Hold & Win. The Claw system collects multipliers, increases respins and can add new Scatters.
great-clawsby-deluxe.feature: Mystery Box changes the bonus state through a multiplier upgrade, extra respins or a Scatter drop. Progress develops within one Hold & Win session.
great-clawsby-deluxe.note: The game's public technical listing reports RTP 95%, low volatility and maximum win 6 992x. Check the active operator configuration separately.

fruit-train-express-hold-win.description: A 5 × 3 fruit grid leads into Hold & Win with coin symbols and jackpot levels. The base remains straightforward, while most state progression moves into the bonus.
fruit-train-express-hold-win.feature: Coin symbols stay fixed in Hold & Win. New coins maintain the respin sequence, while buy/ante options change the route into the feature.
fruit-train-express-hold-win.note: Industry catalogues report RTP 97%, high volatility and maximum win of around 4 500x for the published version. Check the operator's configuration in the game.

hot-and-spicy-jackpot.description: An ordinary 5 × 3 fruit grid is supplemented by a separate 1 × 3 Chilly Mini Slot, which determines the current spin's multiplier.
hot-and-spicy-jackpot.feature: Three pepper reels spin above the main grid. A separate Spicy Jackpots system contains five local prize levels from Minor to Grand.
hot-and-spicy-jackpot.note: Onlyplay publishes RTP 96.06% and medium volatility. The mini-slot modifies the payout, rather than constituting a second independent bet.

wild-west-girls.description: A Western theme on a conventional 5 × 3 grid with twenty paylines. The main rhythm does not change the grid's geometry; special symbols increase individual wins and the bonus.
wild-west-girls.feature: Wilds help form payline combinations, Scatters open free spins, and random multipliers add variation over the fixed grid.
wild-west-girls.note: The public release listing reports RTP 95.36% and medium volatility. Check the operator configuration before playing for money.

caramelo-jackpot.description: A Brazilian-themed 5 × 3 game with a separate mini-slot above the main grid. The upper section sets multipliers without changing the base payline payout method.
caramelo-jackpot.feature: Sticky Wilds start a sequence of extra spins. A separate jackpot game uses several prize levels and its own trigger.
caramelo-jackpot.note: Onlyplay's game page publishes RTP 96.14%, medium volatility and maximum win 10 000x.

coin-flynn.description: Two compact grids work together: the ordinary section forms payline wins, while coin symbols transfer to a separate accumulation grid.
coin-flynn.feature: Five fixed paylines combine with Coin Reel, multiplier Wilds and free spins. Coin accumulation changes the neighbouring grid's state between events.
coin-flynn.note: Onlyplay publishes RTP 97% and high volatility. The game page lists maximum win 5 831x.

coin-craze-jackpot.description: A 5 × 3 payline grid moves into a coin-respin state. Special coins stay fixed, while four jackpot levels and Claim Win change when the bonus ends.
coin-craze-jackpot.feature: Sticky coins remain on the grid during respins, and new coins maintain the bonus. Claim Win allows the accumulated result to be collected within the feature.
coin-craze-jackpot.note: Public catalogues list RTP 95% for the release. Check the specific maximum and configuration in the operator's help menu.
